ayahs.1: Allah aur us ke Rasool ki jaanib se bezaari ka ailaan hai. Un mushrikon ke baare mein jin se tum ne ahd-o-paimaan kiya tha.
ayahs.2: Pas (aye mushriko!) tum mulk mein chaar mahine tak to chal phir lo, jaan lo ke tum Allah ko aajiz karne wale nahi ho, aur yeh (bhi yaad rahe) ke Allah kaafiron ko ruswa karne wala hai.
ayahs.3: Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taraf se logon ko bade hajj ke din saaf ittila hai ke Allah mushrikon se bezaar hai, aur us ka Rasool bhi, agar ab bhi tum tauba kar lo to tumhare haq mein behtar hai, aur agar tum rogardani karo to jaan lo ke tum Allah ko hara nahi sakte. Aur kaafiron ko dukh aur maar ki khabar pahuncha dijiye.
ayahs.4: Bajuz un mushrikon ke jin se tumhara muahida ho chuka hai aur unhon ne tumhe zara sa bhi nuqsaan nahi pahunchaya na kisi ki tumhare khilaaf madad ki hai to tum bhi un ke muahide ki muddat un ke saath poori karo, Allah Taala parhezgaron ko dost rakhta hai.
ayahs.5: Phir hurmat wale mahino ke guzarte hi mushrikon ko jahaan paao qatl karo unhe giraftar karo, un ka muhasara karlo aur un ki taak mein har ghaati mein ja baitho, haan agar woh tauba karlen aur namaz ke paband ho jaayen aur zakaat ada karne lagen to tum un ki raahen chhod do. Yaqeenan Allah Taala bakhshne wala meharban hai.
ayahs.6: Agar mushrikon mein se koi tujh se panaah talab kare to tu use panaah de de yahaan tak ke woh kalaamullah sun le phir use apni jaaye aman tak pahuncha de. Yeh is liye ke yeh log be-ilm hain.
ayahs.7: Mushrikon ke liye ahd Allah aur us ke Rasool ke nazdeek kaise reh sakta hai siwaaye un ke jin se tum ne ahd-o-paimaan Masjid-e-Haram ke paas kiya hai, jab tak woh log tum se muahida nibhaayen tum bhi un se wafadari karo, Allah Taala muttaqiyon se muhabbat rakhta hai.
ayahs.8: Un ke waadon ka kya aitibaar un ka agar tum par ghalba ho jaaye to na yeh qarabatdari ka khayaal karen na ahd-o-paimaan ka, apni zabaanon se to tumhe parcha rahe hain lekin un ke dil nahi maante un mein se aksar to faasiq hain.
ayahs.9: Unhon ne Allah ki aayaton ko bahut kam qeemat par bech diya aur us ki raah se roka. Bahut bura hai jo yeh kar rahe hain.
ayahs.10: Yeh to kisi musalmaan ke haq mein kisi rishtedari ka ya ahd ka mutlaq lihaaz nahi karte, yeh hain hi hadd se guzarne wale.
ayahs.11: Ab bhi agar yeh tauba kar len aur namaz ke paband ho jaayen aur zakaat dete rahen to tumhare deeni bhai hain. Hum to jaanne walon ke liye apni aayaten khol khol kar bayaan kar rahe hain.
ayahs.12: Agar yeh log ahd-o-paimaan ke baad bhi apni qasmon ko tod den aur tumhare deen mein taana-zani karen to tum bhi un sardaran-e-kufr se bhid jaao. Un ki qasmen koi cheez nahi, mumkin hai ke is tarah woh bhi baaz aajaayen.
ayahs.13: Tum un logon ki sarkobi ke liye kyun taiyaar nahi hote jinhon ne apni qasmon ko tod diya aur Paighambar ko jila-watan karne ki fikr mein hain aur khud hi awwal baar unhon ne tum se chhed ki hai, kya tum un se darte ho? Allah hi ziyaada mustahiq hai ke tum us ka dar rakho bashartike tum imaan wale ho.
ayahs.14: Un se tum jang karo Allah Taala unhe tumhare haathon azaab dega, unhe zaleel-o-ruswa karega, tumhe un par madad dega aur musalmaanon ke kaleje thande karega.
ayahs.15: Aur un ke dil ka gham-o-ghussa door karega, aur woh jis ki taraf chaahta hai rehmat se tawajjoh farmata hai. Allah jaanta boojhta hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.16: Kya tum yeh samjhe baithe ho ke tum chhod diye jaao ge haalaanke ab tak Allah ne tum mein se unhe mumtaaz nahi kiya jo mujahid hain aur jinhon ne Allah ke aur us ke Rasool ke aur mominon ke siwa kisi ko dili dost nahi banaya. Allah khoob khabardaar hai jo tum kar rahe ho.
ayahs.17: Laaeq nahi ke mushrik Allah Taala ki masjidon ko aabaad karen. Daraaan haalaanke woh khud apne kufr ke aap hi gawaah hain, un ke aamaal ghaarat-o-akaarat hain, aur woh daaemi taur par jahannami hain.
ayahs.18: Allah ki masjidon ki raunaq-o-aabaadi to un ke hisse mein hai jo Allah par aur qayamat ke din par imaan rakhte hon, namazon ke paband hon, zakaat dete hon, Allah ke siwa kisi se na darte hon, tawaqqo hai ke yahi log yaqeenan hidayat-yafta hain.
ayahs.19: Kya tum ne hajiyon ko paani pila dena aur Masjid-e-Haram ki khidmat karna us ke baraabar kar diya hai jo Allah par aur aakhirat ke din par imaan laaye aur Allah ki raah mein jihad kiya, yeh Allah ke nazdeek baraabar ke nahi aur Allah Taala zaalimon ko hidayat nahi deta.
ayahs.20: Jo log imaan laaye, hijrat ki, Allah ki raah mein apne maal aur apni jaan se jihad kiya woh Allah ke haan bahut bade martaba wale hain, aur yahi log muraad paane wale hain.
ayahs.21: Unhe un ka Rabb khushkhabri deta hai apni rehmat ki aur razamandi ki aur jannaton ki, un ke liye wahaan dawami nemat hai.
ayahs.22: Wahaan yeh hamesha rehne wale hain Allah ke paas yaqeenan bahut bade sawaab hain.
ayahs.23: Aye imaan walo! Apne baapon ko aur apne bhaiyon ko dost na banao agar woh kufr ko imaan se ziyaada azeez rakhen. Tum mein se jo bhi un se muhabbat rakhega woh poora gunahgaar zaalim hai.
ayahs.24: Aap keh dijiye ke agar tumhare baap aur tumhare ladke aur tumhare bhai aur tumhari biwiyaan aur tumhare kumbe qabile aur tumhare kamaaye hue maal aur woh tijaarat jis ki kami se tum darte ho aur woh haweliyaan jinhe tum pasand karte ho agar yeh tumhe Allah se aur us ke Rasool se aur us ki raah mein jihad se bhi ziyaada azeez hain, to tum intezaar karo ke Allah Taala apna azaab le aaye. Allah Taala faasiqon ko hidayat nahi deta.
ayahs.25: Yaqeenan Allah Taala ne bahut se maidanon mein tumhe fatah di hai aur Hunain ki ladaai wale din bhi jab ke tumhe apni kasrat par naaz hogaya tha, lekin us ne tumhe koi faaida na diya balke zameen ba-wujood apni kushaadgi ke tum par tang hogayi phir tum peeth pher kar mud gaye.
ayahs.26: Phir Allah ne apni taraf ki taskeen apne Nabi par aur mominon par utaari aur apne woh lashkar bheje jinhe tum dekh nahi rahe the aur kaafiron ko poori saza di. Un kuffaar ka yahi badla tha.
ayahs.27: Phir us ke baad bhi jis par chaahe Allah Taala apni rehmat ki tawajjoh farmaayega Allah hi bakhshish-o-meharbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.28: Aye imaan walo! Be-shak mushrik bilkul hi napaak hain woh is saal ke baad Masjid-e-Haram ke paas bhi na phatakne paayen agar tumhe muflisi ka khauf hai to Allah tumhe daulatmand kar dega apne fazl se agar chaahe Allah ilm-o-hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.29: Un logon se lado, jo Allah par aur qayamat ke din par imaan nahi laate jo Allah aur us ke Rasool ki haraam karda shai ko haraam nahi jaante, na deen-e-haq ko qubool karte hain un logon mein jinhe kitaab di gayi hai, yahaan tak ke woh zaleel-o-khwaar ho kar apne haath se jizya ada karen.
ayahs.30: Yahood kehte hain Uzair Allah ka beta hai aur nasraani kehte hain Maseeh Allah ka beta hai yeh qaul sirf un ke munh ki baat hai. Agle munkiron ki baat ki yeh bhi naql karne lage Allah unhe ghaarat kare woh kaise paltaaye jaate hain.
ayahs.31: Un logon ne Allah ko chhod kar apne aalim aur darweshon ko Rabb banaya hai aur Maryam ke bete Maseeh ko haalaanke unhe sirf ek akele Allah hi ki ibaadat ka hukm diya gaya tha jis ke siwa koi mabood nahi woh paak hai un ke shareek muqarrar karne se.
ayahs.32: Woh chaahte hain ke Allah ke noor ko apne munh se bujha den aur Allah Taala inkaari hai magar isi baat ka ke apna noor poora kare go kaafir na khush rahen.
ayahs.33: Isi ne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur sachche deen ke saath bheja hai ke use aur tamam mazhabon par ghalib kar de agarche mushrik bura manen.
ayahs.34: Aye imaan walo! Aksar ulama aur abid, logon ka maal na-haq kha jaate hain aur Allah ki raah se rok dete hain aur jo log sone chaandi ka khazana rakhte hain aur Allah ki raah mein kharch nahin karte, unhe dardnaak azaab ki khabar pahuncha dijiye.
ayahs.35: Jis din is khazane ko aatish-e-dozakh mein tapaya jayega phir is se un ki peshaniyan aur pehlu aur peethen daaghi jayengi (un se kaha jayega) yeh hai jise tum ne apne liye khazana bana kar rakha tha. Pas apne khazanon ka maza chakho.
ayahs.36: Mahinon ki ginti Allah ke nazdeek kitab Allah mein barah ki hai, isi din se jab se aasman-o-zameen ko us ne paida kiya hai is mein se chaar hurmat-o-adab ke hain. Yahi durust deen hai, tum in mahinon mein apni jaanon par zulm na karo aur tum tamam mushrikon se jihad karo jaise ke woh tum sab se ladte hain aur jaan rakho ke Allah Taala muttaqiyon ke saath hai.
ayahs.37: Mahinon ka aage peechhe kar dena kufr ki ziyadati hai is se woh log gumraahi mein daale jaate hain jo kaafir hain. Ek saal to ise halal kar lete hain aur ek saal isi ko hurmat wala kar lete hain, ke Allah ne jo hurmat rakhi hai us ke shumaar mein to muwafaqat kar len phir ise halal bana len jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai unhe un ke bure kaam bhale dikha diye gaye hain aur qaum-e-kuffar ki Allah rehnumai nahin farmata.
ayahs.38: Aye imaan walo! Tumhe kya ho gaya hai ke jab tum se kaha jaata hai ke chalo Allah ke raaste mein kooch karo to tum zameen se lage jaate ho. Kya tum aakhirat ke iwaz dunya ki zindagani par hi reejh gaye ho. Suno! Dunya ki zindagi to aakhirat ke muqable mein kuch yunhi si hai.
ayahs.39: Agar tum ne kooch na kiya to tumhe Allah Taala dardnaak saza dega aur tumhare siwa aur logon ko badal layega, tum Allah Taala ko koi nuqsan nahin pahuncha sakte aur Allah har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.40: Agar tum in (Nabi sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ki madad na karo to Allah hi ne in ki madad ki is waqt jabke unhe kaafiron ne (des se) nikaal diya tha, do mein se doosra jabke woh dono ghaar mein the jab yeh apne saathi se keh rahe the ke gham na kar Allah hamare saath hai, pas Janab-e-Baari ne apni taraf se taskeen is par naazil farma kar un lashkaron se is ki madad ki jinhe tum ne dekha hi nahin, is ne kaafiron ki baat past kar di aur buland-o-aziz to Allah ka kalima hi hai, Allah ghalib hai hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.41: Nikal khade ho jaao halke phulke ho to bhi aur bhaari bharkam ho to bhi, aur raah-e-Rabb mein apne maal-o-jaan se jihad karo, yahi tumhare liye behtar hai agar tum mein ilm ho.
ayahs.42: Agar jald wasool hone wala maal-o-asbab hota aur halka safar hota to yeh zaroor aap ke peechhe ho lete lekin un par to doori aur daraaz ki mushkil pad gayi. Ab to yeh Allah ki qasmen khayenge ke agar hum mein quwwat-o-taqat hoti to hum yaqeenan aap ke saath nikalte, yeh apni jaanon ko khud hi halakat mein daal rahe hain un ke jhoota hone ka sachcha ilm Allah ko hai.
ayahs.43: Allah tujhe maaf farma de, tu ne unhe kyun ijazat de di? Baghair is ke ke tere saamne sachche log khul jayen aur tu jhoote logon ko bhi jaan le.
ayahs.44: Allah par aur qayamat ke din par imaan-o-yaqeen rakhne wale to maali aur jaani jihad se ruk rehne ki kabhi bhi tujh se ijazat talab nahin karenge, aur Allah Taala parhezgaron ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.45: Yeh ijazat to tujh se wohi talab karte hain jinhe na Allah par imaan hai na aakhirat ke din ka yaqeen hai jin ke dil shak mein pade hue hain aur woh apne shak mein hi sargardan hain.
ayahs.46: Agar un ka irada jihad ke liye nikalne ka hota to woh is safar ke liye samaan ki tayyari kar rakhte lekin Allah ko un ka uthna pasand hi na tha is liye unhe harkat se hi rok diya aur keh diya gaya ke tum baithne walon ke saath baithe hi raho.
ayahs.47: Agar yeh tum mein mil kar nikalte bhi to tumhare liye siwaye fasad ke aur koi cheez na badhate balke tumhare darmiyan khoob ghode dauda dete aur tum mein fitne daalne ki talash mein rehte un ke maanne wale khud tum mein maujood hain, aur Allah in zaalimon ko khoob jaanta hai.
ayahs.48: Yeh to is se pehle bhi fitne ki talash karte rahe hain aur tere liye kaamon ko ulat pulat karte rahe hain, yahan tak ke haq aa pahuncha aur Allah ka hukm ghalib aa gaya bawajood yeh ke woh nakhushi mein hi rahe.
ayahs.49: Un mein se koi to kehta hai mujhe ijazat dijiye mujhe fitne mein na daaliye, aagah raho woh to fitne mein pad chuke hain aur yaqeenan dozakh kaafiron ko gher lene wali hai.
ayahs.50: Aap ko agar koi bhalai mil jaye to unhe bura lagta hai aur koi burai pahunch jaye to yeh kehte hain hum ne to apna maamla pehle se hi durust kar liya tha, phir to bade hi itraate hue lautte hain.
ayahs.51: Aap keh dijiye ke hamein siwaye Allah ke hamare haq mein likhe hue ke koi cheez pahunch hi nahin sakti woh hamara karsaz aur maula hai. Mominon ko to Allah ki zaat-e-paak par hi bharosa karna chahiye.
ayahs.52: Keh dijiye ke tum hamare baare mein jis cheez ka intezar kar rahe ho woh do bhalaiyon mein se ek hai aur hum tumhare haq mein is ka intezar karte hain ke ya to Allah Taala apne paas se koi saza tumhe de ya hamare haathon se, pas ek taraf tum muntazir raho doosri janib tumhare saath hum bhi muntazir hain.
ayahs.53: Keh dijiye ke tum khushi ya nakhushi kisi tarah bhi kharch karo qubool to hargiz na kiya jayega, yaqeenan tum faasiq log ho.
ayahs.54: Koi sabab un ke kharch ki qubooliyat ke na hone ka is ke siwa nahin ke yeh Allah aur us ke Rasool ke munkir hain aur badi kaahili se hi namaz ko aate hain aur bure dil se hi kharch karte hain.
ayahs.55: Pas aap ko un ke maal-o-aulad taajjub mein na daal den. Allah ki chahat yahi hai ke is se unhe dunya ki zindagi mein hi saza de aur un ke kufr hi ki halat mein un ki jaanen nikal jayen.
ayahs.56: Yeh Allah ki qasam kha kha kar kehte hain ke yeh tumhari jamaat ke log hain, halanke woh darasal tumhare nahin baat sirf itni hai ke yeh darpok log hain.
ayahs.57: Agar yeh koi bachao ki jagah ya koi ghaar ya koi bhi sar ghusane ki jagah paa len to abhi is tarah lagaam tod kar ulte bhaag chhooten.
ayahs.58: Un mein woh bhi hain jo khairati maal ki taqseem ke baare mein aap par aib rakhte hain, agar unhe is mein se mil jaye to khush hain aur agar is mein se na mila to foran bigad khade hue.
ayahs.59: Agar yeh log Allah aur Rasool ke diye hue par khush rehte aur keh dete ke Allah hamein kaafi hai Allah hamein apne fazl se dega aur us ka Rasool bhi, hum to Allah ki zaat se hi tawaqqu rakhne wale hain.
ayahs.60: Sadaqe sirf faqeeron ke liye hain aur miskeenon ke liye aur un ke wasool karne walon ke liye aur un ke liye jin ke dil parchaye jaate hon aur gardan chhudane mein aur qarzdaron ke liye aur Allah ki raah mein aur raahrau musafiron ke liye, farz hai Allah ki taraf se, aur Allah ilm-o-hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.61: Un mein se woh bhi hain jo Paighambar ko eeza dete hain aur kehte hain kaan ka kaccha hai, aap keh dijiye ke woh kaan tumhare bhale ke liye hai woh Allah par imaan rakhta hai aur musalmanon ki baat ka yaqeen karta hai aur tum mein se jo ahl-e-imaan hain yeh un ke liye rehmat hai, Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ko jo log eeza dete hain un ke liye dukh ki maar hai.
ayahs.62: Mehaz tumhe khush karne ke liye tumhare saamne Allah ki qasmen kha jaate hain halanke agar yeh imaan-dar hote to Allah aur us ka Rasool razamand karne ke zyada mustahiq the.
ayahs.63: Kya yeh nahin jaante ke jo bhi Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki mukhalifat karega us ke liye yaqeenan dozakh ki aag hai jis mein woh hamesha rehne wala hai, yeh zabardast ruswai hai.
ayahs.64: Munafiqon ko har waqt is baat ka khatka laga rehta hai ke kahin musalmanon par koi soorat na utre jo un ke dilon ki baaten unhe batla de. Keh dijiye ke tum mazaq udate raho. Yaqeenan Allah Taala ise zaahir karne wala hai jis se tum dar dubak rahe ho.
ayahs.65: Agar aap un se poochhen to saaf keh denge ke hum to yunhi aapas mein hans bol rahe the. Keh dijiye ke Allah, us ki aayaten aur us ka Rasool hi tumhare hansi mazaaq ke liye reh gaye hain?
ayahs.66: Tum bahaane na banao, yaqeenan tum apne imaan ke baad be-imaan ho gaye. Agar hum tum mein se kuch logon se darguzar bhi kar len to kuch logon ko un ke jurm ki sangeen saza bhi denge.
ayahs.67: Tamam munaafiq mard-o-aurat aapas mein ek hi hain, yeh buri baaton ka hukm dete hain aur bhali baaton se rokte hain aur apni mutthi band rakhte hain, yeh Allah ko bhool gaye, Allah ne unhe bhula diya. Be-shak munaafiq hi faasiq-o-badkirdar hain.
ayahs.68: Allah Taala un munaafiq mardon, auraton aur kaafiron se jahannam ki aag ka waada kar chuka hai jahaan yeh hamesha rehne wale hain, wahi unhe kaafi hai, un par Allah ki phitkaar hai, aur un hi ke liye daimi azaab hai.
ayahs.69: Misal un logon ke jo tum se pehle the, tum mein se woh zyada quwwat wale the aur zyada maal-o-aulaad wale the, pas woh apna deeni hissa barat gaye, phir tum ne bhi apna hissa barat liya jaise tum se pehle ke log apne hisse se faida-mand hue the aur tum ne bhi isi tarah mazaaqana behas ki jaise ke unhon ne ki thi. Un ke aamaal dunya aur aakhirat mein ghaarat ho gaye. Yahi log nuqsaan paane wale hain.
ayahs.70: Kya unhe apne se pehle logon ki khabren nahin pahunchen, qaum-e-Nooh aur Aad aur Samood aur qaum-e-Ibraheem aur ahl-e-Madyan aur ahl-e-Mutafikat (ulti hui bastiyon ke rehne wale) ki, un ke paas un ke paighambar daleelen le kar pahunche, Allah aisa na tha ke un par zulm kare balke unhon ne khud hi apne upar zulm kiya.
ayahs.71: Momin mard-o-aurat aapas mein ek doosre ke (madadgaar-o-muawin aur) dost hain, woh bhalaiyon ka hukm dete hain aur buraiyon se rokte hain, namazon ko pabandi se baja laate hain, zakat ada karte hain, Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki baat maante hain, yahi log hain jin par Allah Taala bahut jald reham farmayega, be-shak Allah ghalbe wala hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.72: Un imaan-daar mardon aur auraton se Allah ne un jannaton ka waada farmaya hai jin ke neeche nahren lehren le rahi hain jahaan woh hamesha hamesha rehne wale hain aur un saaf suthre pakeeza mehlat ka jo un hameshgi wali jannaton mein hain, aur Allah ki razamandi sab se badi cheez hai, yahi zabardast kamyabi hai.
ayahs.73: Aye Nabi! Kaafiron aur munaafiqon se jihad jaari rakho, aur un par sakht ho jao, un ki asli jagah dozakh hai, jo nihayat badtareen jagah hai.
ayahs.74: Yeh Allah ki qasmen kha kar kehte hain ke unhon ne nahin kaha, haalaanke yaqeenan kufr ka kalima un ki zaban se nikal chuka hai aur yeh apne Islam ke baad kaafir ho gaye hain aur unhon ne us kaam ka qasd bhi kiya jo poora na kar sake. Yeh sirf isi baat ka intiqam le rahe hain ke unhe Allah ne apne fazl se aur us ke Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ne daulat-mand kar diya, agar yeh ab bhi tauba kar len to yeh un ke haq mein behtar hai, aur agar munh mode rahen to Allah Taala unhe dunya-o-aakhirat mein dardnaak azaab dega aur zameen bhar mein un ka koi himayati aur madadgaar na khada hoga.
ayahs.75: Un mein woh bhi hain jinhon ne Allah se ahd kiya tha ke agar woh hamein apne fazl se maal dega to hum zaroor sadqa-o-khairat karenge aur pakki tarah neko-karon mein ho jayenge.
ayahs.76: Lekin jab Allah ne apne fazl se unhe diya to yeh us mein bukhl karne lage aur taal matol karke munh mod liya.
ayahs.77: Pas us ki saza mein Allah ne un ke dilon mein nifaq daal diya Allah se milne ke dinon tak, kyunke unhon ne Allah se kiye hue waade ka khilaaf kiya aur kyunke jhoot bolte rahe.
ayahs.78: Kya woh nahin jaante ke Allah Taala ko un ke dil ka bhed aur un ki sargoshi sab maloom hai aur Allah Taala ghaib ki tamam baaton se khabardaar hai.
ayahs.79: Jo log un musalmanon par tana-zani karte hain jo dil khol kar khairat karte hain aur un logon par jinhen siwaye apni mehnat mazdoori ke aur kuch muyassar hi nahin, pas yeh un ka mazaaq udaate hain, Allah bhi un se tamaskhur karta hai, unhi ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.80: Un ke liye to istighfar kar ya na kar. Agar tu sattar martaba bhi un ke liye istighfar kare to bhi Allah unhe hargiz na bakhshega, yeh is liye ke unhon ne Allah se aur us ke Rasool se kufr kiya, aise faasiq logon ko Rabb-e-Kareem hidayat nahin deta.
ayahs.81: Peechhe reh jaane wale log Rasoolullah (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) ke jaane ke baad apne baithe rehne par khush hain, unhon ne Allah ki raah mein apne maal aur apni jaanon se jihad karna napasand rakha aur unhon ne keh diya ke is garmi mein mat niklo. Keh dijiye ke dozakh ki aag bahut hi sakht garam hai, kaash ke woh samajhte hote.
ayahs.82: Pas unhe chahiye ke bahut kam hansen aur bahut zyada royen, badle mein us ke jo yeh karte the.
ayahs.83: Pas agar Allah Taala aap ko un ki kisi jamaat ki taraf lauta kar wapas le aaye, phir yeh aap se maidan-e-jang mein nikalne ki ijazat talab karen to aap keh dijiye ke tum mere saath hargiz chal nahin sakte aur na mere saath tum dushmanon se ladai kar sakte ho. Tum ne pehli martaba hi baithe rehne ko pasand kiya tha, pas tum peechhe reh jaane walon mein hi baithe raho.
ayahs.84: Un mein se koi mar jaaye to aap us ke janaze ki hargiz namaz na padhen aur na us ki qabr par khade hon. Yeh Allah aur us ke Rasool ke munkir hain aur marte dam tak badkaar be-itaat rahe hain.
ayahs.85: Aap ko un ke maal-o-aulaad kuch bhi bhale na lagen! Allah ki chahat yahi hai ke unhe in cheezon se dunyavi saza de aur yeh apni jaanen nikalne tak kaafir hi rahen.
ayahs.86: Jab koi surat utaari jaati hai to Allah par imaan lao aur us ke Rasool ke saath mil kar jihad karo to un mein se daulat-mandon ka ek tabaqa aap ke paas aa kar yeh keh kar rukhsat le leta hai ke hamein to baithe rehne walon mein hi chhod dijiye.
ayahs.87: Yeh to khana-nasheen auraton ka saath dene par reejh gaye aur un ke dilon par mohar laga di gayi, ab woh kuch samajh aqal nahin rakhte.
ayahs.88: Lekin khud Rasoolullah aur us ke saath ke imaan wale apne maalon aur jaanon se jihad karte hain, yahi log bhalaiyon wale hain aur yahi log kamyabi hasil karne wale hain.
ayahs.89: Un ke liye Allah ne woh jannaten tayyar ki hain jin ke neeche nahren jaari hain jin mein yeh hamesha rehne wale hain. Yeh bahut badi kamyabi hai.
ayahs.90: Badiya-nasheenon mein se uzr wale log haazir hue ke unhe rukhsat de di jaaye aur woh baithe rahe jinhon ne Allah se aur us ke Rasool se jhooti baaten banayi thin. Ab to un mein jitne kuffar hain unhe dukh dene wali maar pahunch kar rahegi.
ayahs.91: Zaeefon par aur bimaron par aur un par jin ke paas kharch karne ko kuch bhi nahin koi harj nahin, bashartike woh Allah aur us ke Rasool ki khair-khwahi karte rahen. Aise neko-karon par ilzam ki koi raah nahin, Allah Taala badi maghfirat-o-rehmat wala hai.
ayahs.92: Haan un par bhi koi harj nahin jo aap ke paas aate hain ke aap unhe sawari muhayya kar den to aap jawab dete hain ke main to tumhari sawari ke liye kuch bhi nahin paata, to woh ranj-o-gham se apni aankhon se aansoo bahaate hue laut jaate hain ke unhe kharch karne ke liye kuch bhi muyassar nahin.
ayahs.93: Be-shak unhi logon par raah-e-ilzam hai jo bawajood daulat-mand hone ke aap se ijazat talab karte hain. Yeh khana-nasheen auraton ka saath dene par khush hain aur un ke dilon par mohar-e-Khudawandi lag chuki hai jis se woh mahaz be-ilm ho gaye hain.
ayahs.94: Yeh log tumhare saamne uzr pesh karenge jab tum un ke paas wapas jaoge. Aap keh dijiye ke yeh uzr pesh mat karo, hum kabhi tum ko sachcha na samjhenge, Allah Taala hum ko tumhari khabar de chuka hai aur aayinda bhi Allah aur us ka Rasool tumhari karguzari dekh lenge, phir aise ke paas lautaye jaoge jo posheeda aur zaahir sab ka jaanne wala hai, phir woh tum ko bata dega jo kuch tum karte the.
ayahs.95: Haan woh ab tumhare saamne Allah ki qasmen kha jayenge jab tum un ke paas wapas jaoge taake tum un ko un ki halat par chhod do. So tum un ko un ki halat par chhod do. Woh log bilkul gande hain aur un ka thikana dozakh hai un kaamon ke badle jinhen woh kiya karte the.
ayahs.96: Yeh is liye qasmen khayenge ke tum un se raazi ho jao. So agar tum un se raazi bhi ho jao to Allah Taala to aise faasiq logon se raazi nahin hota.
ayahs.97: Dehati log kufr aur nifaq mein bahut hi sakht hain aur un ko aisa hona hi chahiye ke un ko un ahkam ka ilm na ho jo Allah Taala ne apne Rasool par nazil farmaye hain aur Allah bada ilm wala badi hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.98: Aur un dehatiyon mein se baaz aise hain ke jo kuch kharch karte hain is ko jurmana samajhte hain aur tum musalmanon ke waste bure waqt ke muntazir rehte hain, bura waqt un hi par padne wala hai aur Allah sunne wala jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.99: Aur baaz ahl-e-dehat mein aise bhi hain jo Allah Taala par aur qayamat ke din par iman rakhte hain aur jo kuch kharch karte hain is ko indallah qurb hasil hone ka zariya aur Rasool ki dua ka zariya banate hain, yaad rakho ke un ka yeh kharch karna be-shak un ke liye moojib-e-qurbat hai, un ko Allah Taala zaroor apni rahmat mein dakhil karega. Allah Taala badi maghfirat wala badi rahmat wala hai.
ayahs.100: Aur jo muhajireen aur ansar sabiq aur muqaddam hain aur jitne log ikhlas ke saath un ke pairav hain Allah un sab se raazi hua aur woh sab is se raazi hue aur Allah ne un ke liye aise bagh muhayya kar rakhe hain jin ke neeche nehren jari hongi jin mein hamesha rahenge yeh badi kamyabi hai.
ayahs.101: Aur kuch tumhare gird-o-pesh walon mein aur kuch Madine walon mein aise munafiq hain ke nifaq par ade hue hain, aap un ko nahin jante, un ko hum jante hain hum un ko dohri saza denge, phir woh bade bhari azaab ki taraf bheje jayenge.
ayahs.102: Aur kuch aur log hain jo apni khata ke iqrari hain jinhon ne mile-jule amal kiye the, kuch bhale aur kuch bure. Allah se umeed hai ke un ki tauba qabool farmaye. Bila-shubha Allah Taala badi maghfirat wala badi rahmat wala hai.
ayahs.103: Aap un ke maalon mein se sadqa le lijiye, jis ke zariye se aap un ko pak saaf kar den aur un ke liye dua kijiye, bila-shubha aap ki dua un ke liye moojib-e-itminan hai aur Allah Taala khoob sunta hai khoob janta hai.
ayahs.104: Kya un ko yeh khabar nahin ke Allah hi apne bandon ki tauba qabool karta hai aur wahi sadaqat ko qabool farmata hai aur yeh ke Allah hi tauba qabool karne mein aur rahmat karne mein kamil hai.
ayahs.105: Keh dijiye ke tum amal kiye jao tumhare amal Allah khud dekh lega aur is ka Rasool aur iman wale (bhi dekh lenge) aur zaroor tum ko aise ke paas jana hai jo tamam chhupi aur khuli cheezon ka jaanne wala hai. So woh tum ko tumhara sab kiya hua batla dega.
ayahs.106: Aur kuch aur log hain jin ka mamla Allah ke hukm aane tak multawi hai un ko saza dega ya un ki tauba qabool kar lega, aur Allah khoob jaanne wala hai bada hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.107: Aur baaz aise hain jinhon ne un aghraz ke liye masjid banai hai ke zarar pahunchayen aur kufr ki baten karen aur imandaron mein tafreeq dalen aur is shakhs ke qiyam ka saman karen jo is se pehle se Allah aur Rasool ka mukhalif hai, aur qasmen kha jayenge ke bajuz bhalai ke aur hamari kuch niyat nahin, aur Allah gawah hai ke woh bilkul jhoote hain.
ayahs.108: Aap is mein kabhi khade na hon. Albatta jis masjid ki buniyad awwal din se taqwa par rakhi gayi hai woh is laiq hai ke aap is mein khade hon, is mein aise aadmi hain ke woh khoob pak hone ko pasand karte hain, aur Allah Taala khoob pak hone walon ko pasand karta hai.
ayahs.109: Phir aaya aisa shakhs behtar hai jis ne apni imarat ki buniyad Allah se darne par aur Allah ki khushnudi par rakhi ho, ya woh shakhs, ke jis ne apni imarat ki buniyad kisi ghati ke kinare par jo ke girne hi ko ho, rakhi ho, phir woh is ko le kar aatish-e-dozakh mein gir pade, aur Allah Taala aise zaalimon ko samajh hi nahin deta.
ayahs.110: Un ki yeh imarat jo unhon ne banai hai hamesha un ke dilon mein shak ki buniyad par (kanta ban kar) khatakti rahegi, haan magar un ke dil hi agar pash-pash ho jayen to khair, aur Allah Taala bada ilm wala badi hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.111: Bila-shubha Allah Taala ne musalmanon se un ki janon ko aur un ke maalon ko is baat ke iwaz mein khareed liya hai ke un ko jannat milegi. Woh log Allah ki raah mein ladte hain jis mein qatl karte hain aur qatl kiye jate hain, is par sachcha wada kiya gaya hai Taurat mein aur Injeel mein aur Quran mein aur Allah se zyada apne ahd ko kaun poora karne wala hai, to tum log apni is bai par jis ka tum ne mamla thehraya hai khushi manao, aur yahi bahut badi kamyabi hai.
ayahs.112: Woh aise hain jo tauba karne wale, ibaadat karne wale, hamd karne wale, roza rakhne wale, (ya raah-e-haq mein safar karne wale) ruku aur sajda karne wale, nek baton ki taleem karne wale aur buri baton se baz rakhne wale aur Allah ki hadon ka khayal rakhne wale hain aur aise momineen ko aap khushkhabri suna dijiye?
ayahs.113: Paighambar ko aur doosre musalmanon ko jaiz nahin ke mushrikeen ke liye maghfirat ki dua mangen agarche woh rishtedar hi hon is amr ke zahir ho jane ke baad ke yeh log dozakhi hain.
ayahs.114: Aur Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ka apne baap ke liye dua-e-maghfirat mangna woh sirf wade ke sabab se tha jo unhon ne is se wada kar liya tha. Phir jab un par yeh baat zahir ho gayi ke woh Allah ka dushman hai to woh is se mehaz be-talluq ho gaye, waqai Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) bade narm dil aur burdbar the.
ayahs.115: Aur Allah aisa nahin karta ke kisi qaum ko hidayat kar ke baad mein gumrah kar de jab tak ke un cheezon ko saaf saaf na batla de jin se woh bachen be-shak Allah Taala har cheez ko khoob janta hai.
ayahs.116: Bila-shubha Allah hi ki saltanat hai aasmanon aur zameen mein. Wahi jilata aur marta hai, aur tumhara Allah ke siwa na koi yaar hai aur na koi madadgar hai.
ayahs.117: Allah Taala ne Paighambar ke haal par tawajjuh farmai aur muhajireen aur ansar ke haal par bhi jinhon ne aisi tangi ke waqt Paighambar ka saath diya, is ke baad ke un mein se ek giroh ke dilon mein kuch tazalzul ho chala tha. Phir Allah ne un ke haal par tawajjuh farmai. Bila-shubha Allah Taala un sab par bahut hi shafeeq meharban hai.
ayahs.118: Aur teen shakhsion ke haal par bhi jin ka mamla multawi chhod diya gaya tha. Yahan tak ke jab zameen bawajood apni farakhi ke un par tang hone lagi aur woh khud apni jaan se tang aa gaye aur unhon ne samajh liya ke Allah se kahin panah nahin mil sakti bajuz is ke ke isi ki taraf rujoo kiya jaye phir un ke haal par tawajjuh farmai taake woh ainda bhi tauba kar saken. Be-shak Allah Taala bahut tauba qabool karne wala bada raham wala hai.
ayahs.119: Ae iman walo! Allah Taala se daro aur sachchon ke saath raho.
ayahs.120: Madina ke rehne walon ko aur jo dehati un ke gird-o-pesh hain un ko yeh zeba na tha ke Rasoolullah ko chhod kar peechhe reh jayen aur na yeh ke apni jaan ko un ki jaan se azeez samjhen, yeh is sabab se ke un ko Allah ki raah mein jo pyas lagi aur jo takan pahunchi aur jo bhook lagi aur jo kisi aisi jagah chale jo kuffar ke liye moojib-e-ghaiz hua ho aur dushmanon ki jo kuch khabar li, un sab par un ke naam (ek ek) nek kaam likha gaya. Yaqeenan Allah Taala mukhliseen ka ajr zaya nahin karta.
ayahs.121: Aur jo kuch chhota bada unhon ne kharch kiya aur jitne maidan un ko tai karne pade, yeh sab bhi un ke naam likha gaya taake Allah Taala un ke kaamon ka achchhe se achchha badla de.
ayahs.122: Aur musalmanon ko yeh na chahiye ke sab ke sab nikal khade hon so aisa kyun na kiya jaye ke un ki har badi jamaat mein se ek chhoti jamaat jaya kare taake woh deen ki samajh-boojh hasil karen aur taake yeh log apni qaum ko jab ke woh un ke paas aayen, darayen taake woh dar jayen.
ayahs.123: Ae iman walo! Un kuffar se lado jo tumhare aas paas hain aur un ko tumhare andar sakhti pana chahiye. Aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah Taala muttaqi logon ke saath hai.
ayahs.124: Aur jab koi surat nazil ki jati hai to baaz munafiqeen kehte hain ke is surat ne tum mein se kis ke iman ko zyada kiya hai, so jo log iman wale hain is surat ne un ke iman ko zyada kiya hai aur woh khush ho rahe hain.
ayahs.125: Aur jin ke dilon mein rog hai is surat ne un mein un ki gandagi ke saath aur gandagi badha di aur woh halat-e-kufr hi mein mar gaye.
ayahs.126: Aur kya un ko nahin dikhlai deta ke yeh log har saal ek baar ya do baar kisi na kisi aafat mein phanste rehte hain phir bhi na tauba karte aur na naseehat qabool karte hain.
ayahs.127: Aur jab koi surat nazil ki jati hai to ek doosre ko dekhne lagte hain ke tum ko koi dekhta to nahin phir chal dete hain Allah Taala ne un ka dil pher diya hai is wajah se ke woh be-samajh log hain.
ayahs.128: Tumhare paas ek aise Paighambar tashreef laye hain jo tumhari jins se hain jin ko tumhari muzarrat ki baat nihayat giran guzarti hai jo tumhari manfa-at ke bade khwahishmand rehte hain iman walon ke saath bade hi shafeeq aur meharban hain.
ayahs.129: Phir agar roo-gardani karen to aap keh dijiye ke mere liye Allah kafi hai, is ke siwa koi mabood nahin. Main ne isi par bharosa kiya aur woh bade arsh ka malik hai.
